Exact huge text: "SKILL ISSUE". A funny smug cartoon orange cat face wearing tiny pixel sunglasses beside the words; meme-inspired original illustration. Deep midnight navy background, bold warm white condensed block typography, acid yellow angular accents. One horizontal line, typography and cat occupy the central 70% of height with 8% padding all sides. Extremely clear silhouettes and heavy readable type for a tiny distant LED board. Edge-to-edge flat dark background, no border, no perspective, no lighting baked into texture, no gradients or noise, no extra text, no sponsor logos. The tile will be repeated horizontally across a 16:1 stadium board.

prompts.ball: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready square 1024x1024 flat seamless soccer ball albedo texture for an existing spherical UV map. NOT a picture of a ball, no sphere, no mockup, no perspective. Edge-to-edge repeating tessellated soccer panels: mostly ivory white hexagonal panels with thin dark navy seams and occasional deep navy pentagonal panels. Several white panels carry a simple small cheeky comic smile face with black dot eyes; a few carry the bold compact word "BONK" in navy. Small neon orange comic impact stars in a few dark panels. Original goofy meme match ball, clean sporty styling and high visibility on green grass. Keep roughly 75% of surface white and only 20% navy with 5% orange; no giant dark regions. Panels uniformly sized, seamless opposite edges, flat diffuse color with faint leather microtexture, no shine, no highlights, no shadows, no green, no trademarks, no other text. Faces and BONK motifs should be comfortably inset inside panels, not on seams.
